claim_citation_map.claim: PPO uses a clipped surrogate objective for stable policy updates.
Pointer mechanisms select variable-length input positions and suit combinatorial sequence construction.
Multi-head attention represents interactions among candidate inspection points.
A2C is an actor-critic comparator from the asynchronous advantage-learning lineage.
Safety in reinforcement learning can be imposed through action restriction or constrained optimisation, not only reward penalties.
Domain randomisation is a recognised strategy for transfer across simulated condition variations.
Rotorcraft propulsion energy depends on speed and flight regime; simplified proxies require explicit limitations.
Map-level paired non-parametric tests and multiplicity correction avoid treating routes as independent replicates.
Copernicus DEM GLO-30 is a public 30 m digital surface model source.
EAAI has published closely related UAV inspection, navigation, wind-robustness, and terrain-risk studies.
